name: Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich on Toasted Brioche
whyItWorks: Tender, boneless chicken breast grilled cleanly without heavy blackening spices served on a soft bakery brioche bun provides lean bioavailable protein that is gentle on sensitive intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the chicken sandwich plain with meat and bun only. Skip bacon, house garage sauce, raw onions, and pickles. Pair with a side of white toast or applesauce.
